overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated YouTube Shorts data reveals a strong viewer preference for extreme space scenarios, cosmic what-if questions, and bizarre planetary facts, particularly those featuring high-stakes hypothetical outcomes or rare physical anomalies. Videos focusing on 'What If' space scenarios (e.g., liquid diamond planets, burning ice worlds) and extreme celestial phenomena achieve the highest views-per-day and engagement-per-view ratios within the crucial 7-day window. Conversely, repetitive psychological trivia and older biological facts show diminishing momentum. Growth should double down on visual, high-scale cosmic and planetary what-if scenarios while introducing a fresh, unmined celestial phenomenon.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) accumulated 1,024 and 972 views rapidly with exceptional like-to-view ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more high-stakes hypothetical planetary survival or immersion scenarios involving extreme physical states.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) pulled strong view counts (970+ and 1,026 views) with high engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on counter-intuitive time, light, or weather anomalies on newly discovered or lesser-known exoplanets.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts covering repetitive memory or earworm topics (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head') stagnated in the single and double digits (5 to 53 views).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks and brain hacks unless paired with a high-concept, highly visual mystery narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (when repeated or outdated relative to fresh space content) underperform compared to cosmic extremes.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content strictly into cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies rather than basic static trivia.
